verdict.rationale: Increase has a compliance overview: customers are modeled as Entities, and Increase exposes Entity validations via the API while the platform is expected to follow up with its customers on data issues. That hints at a division of responsibilities but covers onboarding data checks rather than the ops tooling the story asks for. Community notes that accounts sit at partner banks (First Internet Bank / Blue Ridge Bank), which confirms a three-party sponsor model, but nothing describes how compliance duties are split with the bank. Missing for 10: transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, alert case management, SAR-filing support, a documented platform/Increase/bank responsibility matrix, and independent corroboration.
